scope: Restore source-defined pollinator summary calculations to the tenant-scoped Kernel read path

implementation.observation_trends: Verified/reviewed observations from the last 30 days, compared across equal 15-day windows; increasing/decreasing thresholds remain +/-10 percent, matching the legacy calculation.
implementation.pesticide_risk: Verified/reviewed applications from the last 90 days; critical for any reported mortality or at least three high/very-high toxicity records, elevated for one or more high/very-high records, otherwise low. Recorded rows remain excluded by the governed read contract.
implementation.active_hives: Active-hive count and mean non-null colony_strength_score (0-10), preserving separation from categorical colony strength.

synthetic_regressions: 10-to-12 mean observation count yields increasing at 20.0 percent
exact +10% and -10% boundaries remain stable; negative trend and zero-baseline cases preserve legacy behavior
moderate-only pesticide reports remain low risk; one high-toxicity report is elevated
three high-toxicity reports cross the critical threshold
one reported mortality event yields critical risk
active-hive score aggregation returns the expected 0-10 mean

rollback: Revert the Gateway and console source change; no schema or persistent state changed.
